text.p: Dutch food and drinks group BolsWessanen NV said on Wednesday the joint venture with Golden Poultry International Ltd, Bangkok, announced in December last year, had now been officially established.
BolsWessanen has a controlling interest and will have management control in Golden Foods International Co., which will have annual sales of some $100 million (180 million guilders).
"This turnover is expected to double within the next five years," said BolsWessanen in a statement.
BolsWessanen said it anticipated the joint venture would generate a positive contribution to the profit per share of BolsWessanen as from 1998.
It said the effect on the results of the current year were expected to be neutral.
Bols will finance the participation from its own resources.
